pairs: Hæc sunt nomina filiorum Israël qui ingressi sunt in Ægyptum cum Jacob:
These are the names of the sons of Israel, who went into Egypt with Jacob.
They entered, each one with his house:
Erant igitur omnes animæ eorum qui egressi sunt de femore Jacob,
all the souls of those who went forth from Jacob’s thigh were seventy.
along with all of his brothers
Surrexit interea rex novus super Ægyptum,
Meanwhile, there arose a new king over Egypt,
And he said to his people:
the people of the sons of Israel are many,
and they are stronger than we are.
Come, let us wisely oppress them,
et si ingruerit contra nos bellum,
and if any war should advance against us,
they may be added to our enemies,
and having fought against us, they might depart from the land.”
And so he set over them masters of the works,
in order to afflict them with burdens.
And they built for Pharaoh the cities of the tabernacles:
And the more they oppressed them,
so much more did they multiply
And the Egyptians hated the sons of Israel,
and they afflicted them and mocked them.
atque ad amaritudinem perducebant vitam eorum operibus duris luti
And they led their life directly into bitterness,
with hard work in clay and brick,
and with all kinds of servitude,
so that they were being overwhelmed with the works of the land.
Dixit autem rex Ægypti obstetricibus Hebræorum,
Then the king of Egypt spoke to the midwives of the Hebrews,
(one of whom one was called Shiphrah,
“When you will act as a midwife to the Hebrew women,
and the time of delivery has arrived:
et non fecerunt juxta præceptum regis Ægypti,
and so they did not act according to the precept of the king of Egypt,
but they kept the males safe.
Quidnam est hoc quod facere voluistis,
so that you would save the boys?”
Non sunt Hebreæ sicut ægyptiæ mulieres:
“The Hebrew women are not like the Egyptian women.
For they themselves have the wisdom of a midwife,
et priusquam veniamus ad eas, pariunt.
and so they give birth before we can come to them.”
Therefore, God acted favorably toward the midwives.
And because the midwives feared God,
Præcepit ergo Pharao omni populo suo,
Therefore, Pharaoh instructed all his people,
